name: portfolio-loc-maxxer
description: Leveraged Investing Strategy Analyzer with WebAssembly acceleration

scripts.asbuild: npm run asbuild:optimized && npm run asbuild:math && npm run asbuild:stats
scripts.asbuild:math: asc assembly/math.ts --target release --outFile build/math.wasm --textFile build/math.wat --sourceMap --bindings esm
scripts.asbuild:stats: asc assembly/stats.ts --target release --outFile build/stats.wasm --textFile build/stats.wat --sourceMap --bindings esm
